senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בל , v. בלל; cmp. נבל) to be crumbled; to be worn out, to fail, decay, perish.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:4:5">Koh. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>הוא בוֹלֶה</he> it (the generation of man) decays (dies out), <he>אינה בוֹלָה</he> it (the earth) does not grow old.

Taan. 9ᵃ (play on עד בלי די Mal. III, 10) עד שיִבְלוּ שפתותיכם מלומר די until your lips grow tired from saying, It is enough; (Y. ib. III, 66ᵈ bot. שיבללו, v. בָּלַל); a. fr.—Part. pass. בָּלוּי outworn. Pl. בְּלוּיִים.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 25:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4:8">Lev. R. s. 4</cite> <he>הנפש מְבַלָּה וכ׳</he> the soul survives the body.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:2">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (play on <he>אין בלתך</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 2:2">I Sam. II, 2</cite>) <he>אין לְבַלּוֹתֶךָ</he> there is none to outlive thee. Koh. R. l. c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:15">Cant. R. to V, 15</cite> one erects a building <he>ואחר מְבַלֶּה אותו</he> (not <he>מכלה</he>) and another man ruins it.

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְבַּלָּה to become outworn, fade away. Esth. R. introd. עתידין לְהִבָּלוֹת (Gen. R. s. 42 לִבְלוֹת) are destined to decay.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>נִתְבַּלּוּ</he> (the garments) were worn out.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 87a">B. Mets. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ הבשר</he> her body was withered.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 146a:7">B. Bath. 146ᵃ</cite> <he>עשויין לִיבָּלוֹת</he> made to be used up.
